t: What is required to benefit from a reminder
a: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
p: Inna fī dhālika la-dhikrā li-man kāna lahu qalbun aw alqa-s-samʿa wa huwa shahīd.
m: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
